FIELDS.NAME: Mason & Concrete Solutions, LLC
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Mason & Concrete Solutions, LLC specializes in providing high-quality concrete and masonry services for both residential and commercial projects. Our operations encompass foundation work, structural concrete, brickwork, and stone installations, with a strong emphasis on craftsmanship and safety. We pride ourselves on employing experienced and licensed contractors who adhere to strict safety protocols, ensuring that all projects are completed efficiently and securely while minimizing liability exposure. We maintain regular safety audits and training programs to promote a culture of safety among our workforce. Additionally, we manage subcontractor relationships through well-defined agreements, which outline risk transfer and liability, further safeguarding our operations and providing peace of mind to our clients.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 08/15/2022, incurred a loss of $1,500 due to an equipment malfunction leading to concrete mix errors on a residential project; currently resolved. Additionally, on 09/30/2023, a claim for $1,000 was filed concerning minor property damage during a masonry repair job; status is pending.

FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 7:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 8:00 AM - 3:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and security personnel on-site during active projects to enhance safety and mitigate unauthorized access.

FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Mason & Concrete Solutions, LLC does not lease employees to or from other employers, ensuring full control over our workforce and maintaining compliance with labor regulations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Mason & Concrete Solutions, LLC carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with labor regulations and to protect our employees during their work activities. This coverage is in place prior to our policy's effective date.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Mason & Concrete Solutions, LLC also operates Mason & Concrete Restoration, Inc., providing additional concrete and masonry services.

FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Mason & Concrete Solutions, LLC is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our focus is solely on providing concrete and masonry services.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Mason & Concrete Solutions, LLC does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our operations focus on providing concrete and masonry services directly to our clients without engaging in equipment rentals.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Mason & Concrete Solutions, LLC has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. Our financial standing remains stable and compliant.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Mason & Concrete Solutions, LLC does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations are focused solely on standard concrete and masonry services without the use of hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Mason & Concrete Solutions, LLC does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are primarily focused on standard concrete and masonry services without involvement in high-risk activities or locations. We have implemented comprehensive risk management protocols to further mitigate any potential risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – There have been no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring for Mason & Concrete Solutions, LLC. We maintain strict policies and practices to ensure compliance and minimize liability risks.
